trading_rule_update: Never promote absorption/divergence into a long trigger until the exact structural level is visibly reclaimed and held.

lesson: This correction is important training data: the model must separate flow quality from structural confirmation and must correct prior reads when exact chart labels contradict the initial visual impression.
